metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Otto Leftglove
records.biography_en: Otto Leftglove joins Lost and Unmissed as lone glove seeking its partner. “I'm the one with the thumb.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: oversized soft mitten used as an open cap with face wholly visible.

records.name: Nora Keybrella
records.biography_en: Nora Keybrella joins Lost and Unmissed as keeper of lost umbrellas. “The keys came with the rain.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small closed umbrella with three keys tied neatly to its handle.

records.name: Bert Claimwell
records.biography_en: Bert Claimwell joins Lost and Unmissed as visitor inventing a loss at the counter. “It was about this size, probably.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: blank claim slip and pencil poised to improvise.

records.name: Jade Tagloop
records.biography_en: Jade Tagloop joins Lost and Unmissed as clerk matching lost-property tags. “I can match the parcel or the story.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two large plain color tags linked to a small cloth parcel.

records.name: Len Loosebutton
records.biography_en: Len Loosebutton joins Lost and Unmissed as minor-object attendant. “The button is still on hold.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small compartmented tray holding a button and a thimble.

records.name: Cobb Lastcase
records.biography_en: Cobb Lastcase joins Lost and Unmissed as forever-unclaimed suitcase custodian. “Someone will come on Thursday.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny scuffed suitcase with one large paper tag.
